provenance: Authorized bounded DOSBox original V1.07 machine-code comparisons on disposable memory-file copies; these are observed original outputs, not model outputs.
scope: Controlled helper state and peripheral services listed per matrix; no claim of full gameplay equivalence.

manifest.originalCode: Function and CS jump table copied byte-for-byte, preserving offsets; DS3364 supplied by harness. No game entrypoint or other game routines execute.

manifest.limitations: Controlled pool/state context, no GUI/startup/graphics/actual projectile flight or deviation service. Branch decisions, cooldown/RNG and requested projectile are original instructions.
Fixed start coordinate 0x800:0x800. All 256 directions, 18 distances including cap and unsigned maximum. Does not test full-game object motion scheduling.
